script: In dropshipping, a customer buys from your store. You then buy the same item from a supplier, who ships it directly to the customer under your brand. You never hold the stock. Say you sell a water bottle for twenty-four dollars ninety-nine cents, and the supplier charges seven dollars fifty including shipping. Your gross profit is seventeen dollars forty-nine cents, before advertising and fees. The advantages are low start-up cost, no warehouse and flexible hours. The risks are thin margins, long shipping times and dependence on ad platforms. Myth: you can get rich in thirty days. Fact: most new stores lose money at first. Plan for three to six months of testing.
glossary: dropshipping, supplier, ROAS, CPA, stop-loss, Shopify
